description: Create or replace one scoped working-state record for resuming a task, next action, or blocker. Requires memory:write; it versions that state slot and refreshes its expiry without deleting other memories. Use remember for durable facts or record_event for history. Provide content or a structured state field; ttl_seconds=0 means no expiry.

blocked_reason.description: Blocker; used to build the state body when content is blank.

bucket.description: Bucket containing the working-state slot; defaults to work.

content.description: Free-form state body; otherwise provide at least one structured state field.

current_task.description: Current task; used to build the state body when content is blank.

metadata_json.description: JSON object merged into the working-state metadata.

next_action.description: Next action; used to build the state body when content is blank.

scope.description: Scope containing the working-state slot; blank uses the token default.

state_key.description: Normalized state slot; the same owner, bucket, scope, and key updates that slot.

ttl_seconds.description: Expiry in seconds from 0 to 2592000; 0 means no expiry.

name: update_state

result.description: Human-readable text or JSON requested by output_json.
